defaults.MESSAGEOFTHEDAY: Welcome to my Space Engineers Server, GSCS!

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Server Name displayed in the server browser.

configurationFields.label: Weltname
configurationFields.description: World Name displayed in server browser.

configurationFields.label: Steam Group ID
configurationFields.description: Steam Group ID for friends only

configurationFields.label: Server Password Hash
configurationFields.description: Generate the password hash using the [Password Generator](https://sepg.einarjegorov.com/)

configurationFields.label: Server Password Salt
configurationFields.description: Generate the password salt using the [Password Generator](https://sepg.einarjegorov.com/)

configurationFields.label: Ignore Last Session
configurationFields.description: This will ignore the save file and load based on the config every time. This should not be used for survival mode, but can be useful to provide a new world each start for battle sessions.

configurationFields.label: Enable Remote API
configurationFields.description: Enable/Disable the remote API to manage the server from a browser. Remote API Security Key must also be set. NOTE: To work in GSCS on Windows in service mode, run the following as Administrator first (change 8777 to your Remote API Port if needed): netsh http add urlacl url=http://*:8777/vrageremote/ user="NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE"

configurationFields.label: Remote API Security Key
configurationFields.description: The password used to access the Remote API.

configurationFields.label: Remote API Binding IP
configurationFields.description: The IP address to bind the Remote API to. Empty = all IPs. Set to a specific IP if desired - do not set specifically to 0.0.0.0 or the Remote API will not work.

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Server Description displayed in the server browser.

configurationFields.label: Verbose Network Logging
configurationFields.description: Enables additional network logging.

configurationFields.label: Network Type
configurationFields.description: EOS must be selected for cross-platform play. Use in-game server browser filters to display Steam or EOS server lists.

configurationFields.label: Enable Chat Anti-Spam
configurationFields.description: Enables anti-spam measures for in-game chat.

configurationFields.label: Same Message Timeout
configurationFields.description: Time between sending the same message before getting timed out.

configurationFields.label: Spam Messages Time
configurationFields.description: Time between sending multiple messages before getting timed out.

configurationFields.label: Spam Messages Timeout
configurationFields.description: How long to time out a user for spamming.

configurationFields.label: Autodetect Mod Dependencies
configurationFields.description: The server will detect mod dependencies and automatically download on startup.

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day
configurationFields.default: Welcome to my Space Engineers Server, GSCS!
configurationFields.placeholder: Welcome to my Space Engineers Server, GSCS!

configurationFields.label: Log Chat
configurationFields.description: Save chat messages to the log file.

configurationFields.label: Select World Or Scenario
configurationFields.description: Sets the World or Scenario to base the game on. If "Custom" is chosen, you must also fill in the Custom World or Custom Scenario fields.

configurationFields.label: Custom World
configurationFields.description: Set this to the name of the folder you created under the "CustomWorlds" directory.

configurationFields.label: Custom Scenario
configurationFields.description: Set this to the name of the folder you created under the "Scenarios" directory.

configurationFields.label: View Distance
configurationFields.description: Set the distance of how far each client can see objects.

configurationFields.label: Scenario
configurationFields.description: The left side of the screen presents various options for the starting conditions of the world.

configurationFields.label: Can Join Running
configurationFields.description: Whether players can join a running server.

configurationFields.label: Adaptive Simulation Quality
configurationFields.description: Enables adaptive simulation quality system. This system is useful if you have a lot of voxel deformations in the world and a low simulation speed.

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Defines autosave interval.

configurationFields.label: Enable Drop Containers
configurationFields.description: Enable drop containers (unknown signals).

configurationFields.label: Enable Convert To Station
configurationFields.description: Enables possibility of converting grid to station.

configurationFields.label: Enable Good.bot Hints
configurationFields.description: Enables Good.bot hints in the world. If user has diabled hints, this will not override that.

configurationFields.label: Enable Match
configurationFields.description: Enable component handling the match.

configurationFields.label: Enable Remote Grid Removal
configurationFields.description: Enables possibility to remove grid remotely from the world by an author.

configurationFields.label: Enable Progression
configurationFields.description: Enables research progression.

configurationFields.label: Enable Respawn Ships
configurationFields.description: Enables respawn ships.

configurationFields.label: Enable Saving From Menu
configurationFields.description: Enables saving from the menu.

configurationFields.label: Enable Scripter Role
configurationFields.description: Adds a Scripter role, only Scripters and higher ranks will be able to paste and modify scripts. Also requires Experimental Mode enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Selective Physics Updates
configurationFields.description: When enabled game will update physics only in the specific clusters, which are necessary.

configurationFields.label: Enable Team Score Counters
configurationFields.description: Show team scores at the top of the screen.

configurationFields.label: Enable Voxel Hand
configurationFields.description: Enables voxel hand.

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: The type of the game mode.

configurationFields.label: Experimental Mode
configurationFields.description: Enables experimental mode. Playing with mods and some settings require experimental mode. See the wiki for more details: [Experimental Mode](https://spaceengineers.fandom.com/wiki/Experimental_mode)

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Ammunition in Survival
configurationFields.description: Enables infinite ammunition in survival game mode.

configurationFields.label: Match Duration
configurationFields.description: Duration of Match phase of the match. (0 - 60000)

configurationFields.label: Max Backup Saves
configurationFields.description: Max number of backups

configurationFields.label: Max Drop Container Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Defines maximum respawn time for drop containers.

configurationFields.label: Maximum Messages In HUD Chat
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of messages displayed in HUD chat.

configurationFields.label: Max Planet Types
configurationFields.description: Limit maximum number of types of planets in the world.

configurationFields.label: Max Production Queue Length
configurationFields.description: Maximum allowed length of a production queue. Can affect performance. (0 - 99999)

configurationFields.label: Min Drop Container Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Defines minimum respawn time for drop containers.

configurationFields.label: Offensive Words Filtering
configurationFields.description: Filter offensive words from all input methods.

configurationFields.label: PostMatch Duration
configurationFields.description: Duration of PostMatch phase of the match. (0 - 60000)

configurationFields.label: Enable Predefined Asteroids
configurationFields.description: To conserve memory, predefined asteroids has to be disabled on consoles.

configurationFields.label: PreMatch Duration
configurationFields.description: Duration of PreMatch phase of the match. (0 - 60000)

configurationFields.label: Remove Respawn Ships on Logoff
configurationFields.description: When enabled respawn ship is removed after player logout.

configurationFields.label: Enable Thruster Damage
configurationFields.description: Enables thruster damage.

configurationFields.label: Use Console PCU
configurationFields.description: To conserve memory, some of the blocks have different PCU values for consoles.

configurationFields.label: Enable Weapons
configurationFields.description: Enables weapons.

configurationFields.label: AFK Timeout
configurationFields.description: Defines time in minutes after which inactive players will be kicked. 0 is off.

configurationFields.label: Block Count Threshold
configurationFields.description: Defines block count threshold for trash removal system.

configurationFields.label: Enable Trash Settings Platform Override
configurationFields.description: Enable trash settings to be overridden by console specific settings.

configurationFields.label: Optimal Grid Count
configurationFields.description: By setting this, server will keep number of grids around this value. !WARNING! It ignores Powered and Fixed flags, Block count and lowers Distance from player. Set to 0 to disable.

configurationFields.label: Character Removal Threshold
configurationFields.description: Defines character removal threshold for trash removal system. If player disconnects it will remove their character after this time. Set to 0 to disable.

configurationFields.label: Player Distance Threshold
configurationFields.description: Defines Player Distance Threshold for trash removal system.

configurationFields.label: Player Inactivity Threshold
configurationFields.description: Defines player inactivity (time from logout) threshold for trash removal system. !WARNING! This will remove all grids of the player. Set to 0 to disable.

configurationFields.label: Remove Old Identities
configurationFields.description: Defines time in hours after which inactive identities that do not own any grids will be removed. Set to 0 to disable.

configurationFields.label: Reset Forageable Items
configurationFields.description: Enable resetting forageable items.

configurationFields.label: Reset Forageable Items Distance
configurationFields.description: Defines minimum distance from player for forageable items to reset. (1 - 999999)

configurationFields.label: Reset Forageable Items Time
configurationFields.description: Defines time after which forageable items are reset. (1 - 999999)

configurationFields.label: Stop Grids Period
configurationFields.description: Defines time in minutes after which grids will be stopped if far from player. Set to 0 to disable.

configurationFields.label: Trash Removal Flags Value
configurationFields.description: Determined by the combination of checkboxes chosen from the Server Launcher.

configurationFields.label: Trash Removal Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enable trash removal system.

configurationFields.label: Voxel Age
configurationFields.description: Only voxel chunks that have been modified longer than this time may be reverted.

configurationFields.label: Distance Voxel From Grid
configurationFields.description: Only voxel chunks that are further from grid will be reverted.

configurationFields.label: Distance Voxel From Player
configurationFields.description: Only voxel chunks that are further from player will be reverted.

configurationFields.label: Voxel Reverting Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables system for voxel removal

configurationFields.label: Assembler Efficiency
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for assembler efficiency. (1 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Assembler Speed
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for assembler speed. (1 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Blocks Inventory Size
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for inventory size for the blocks. (1 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Grinder Speed
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for grinder speed. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Hacking Speed
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for hacking speed. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Harvest Ratio Multiplier
configurationFields.description: The ratio multiplier for drills. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Characters Inventory Size
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for the inventory size for the characters. (1 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Refinery Speed
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for refinery speed. (1 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Welder Speed
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for welder speed. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Auto Healing
configurationFields.description: Auto-healing heals players only in oxygen environments and during periods of not taking damage.

configurationFields.label: Backpack Despawn Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the timer (minutes) for the backup to be removed from the world. Default is 5 minutes. (0 - 10)

configurationFields.label: Enable Blueprint Share
configurationFields.description: Enable sharing of blueprints.

configurationFields.label: Share Blueprint Timout
configurationFields.description: Timeout between sharing blueprints. Default is 30 minutes.

configurationFields.label: Character Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Character speed multiplier. (.75 - 1)

configurationFields.label: Enable 3rd Person Camera
configurationFields.description: Enables 3rd person camera.

configurationFields.label: Enable Autorespawn
configurationFields.description: Enables automatic respawn at nearest available respawn point.

configurationFields.label: Enable Bounty Contracts
configurationFields.description: If enabled bounty contracts will be available on stations.

configurationFields.label: Enable Copy & Paste
configurationFields.description: Allows players to copy a ship, rover, station, and paste the copy into the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Gamepad Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: Enables aim assist for gamepad.

configurationFields.label: Enable Jetpack
configurationFields.description: Enables jetpack.

configurationFields.label: Enable PCU Trading
configurationFields.description: Enables trading of PCUs between players or factions depending on PCU settings.

configurationFields.label: Enable Weapon Recoil
configurationFields.description: Enables weapon recoil.

configurationFields.label: Enable Reduced Stats
configurationFields.description: Upon respawning, all players will have their health, oxygen, gas tank levels, and other stats set to critically low levels.

configurationFields.label: Enable Space Suit Respawn
configurationFields.description: Enables players to respawn in a space suit.

configurationFields.label: Enable Survival Buffs
configurationFields.description: Enable buffs and enhancements which player characters earn over time. These benefits are lost if the player respawns.

configurationFields.label: Enable Tool Shake
configurationFields.description: Enables tool shake feature.

configurationFields.label: Environment Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: This multiplier only applies for damage caused to the player by the environment. (max 2)

configurationFields.label: Enable Family Sharing
configurationFields.description: Enables shared accounts to join multiplayer games.

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of connected players. (2 - 64)

configurationFields.label: Optimal Respawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets optimal distance in meters the game should take into consideration when spawning new player near others.

configurationFields.label: Show Player Names On HUD
configurationFields.description: If enabled, nearby players will have their names displayed.

configurationFields.label: Respawn Ship Time Multiplier
configurationFields.description: The multiplier for respawn ship timer. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Spawn With Tools
configurationFields.description: Enables spawning with tools in the inventory.

configurationFields.label: Block Limits Mode
configurationFields.description: Defines block limits mode.

configurationFields.label: Max Blocks Per Player
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of blocks per player. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Max Factions Count
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of existing factions in the world. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Max Grid Blocks
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of blocks in one grid. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: World PCU
configurationFields.description: The total number of Performance Cost Units in the world. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Limit Blocks By
configurationFields.description: Sets whether blocks will be limited by Tag or Black Pair Name.

configurationFields.label: Offline Broadcast Controller Distance
configurationFields.description: The maximum distance Broadcast Controller will transmit messages when its owner is offline.

configurationFields.label: Enable Destructible Blocks
configurationFields.description: Enables destruction feature for the blocks.

configurationFields.label: Enable Oxygen
configurationFields.description: Enables oxygen in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Airtightness
configurationFields.description: Enables airtightness in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Radiation
configurationFields.description: Enables radiation hazards. Requires Airtightness.

configurationFields.label: Enable Sun Rotation
configurationFields.description: Enables sun rotation.

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Missile Damage
configurationFields.description: Enables explosion damage from missiles being applied to its own grid.

configurationFields.label: Enable Voxel Destruction
configurationFields.description: Enables voxel destructions.

configurationFields.label: Random Encounter Density
configurationFields.description: Defines density of procedurally generated space encounters.

configurationFields.label: Meteor Activity
configurationFields.description: Sets the frequency and intensity of meteor showers.

configurationFields.label: Food Consumption Rate
configurationFields.description: This value impacts how quickly the player becomes hungry, as well as how quickly food production occurs.

configurationFields.label: Max Cargo Bags
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of existing cargo bags. (2 - 1024)

configurationFields.label: Max Floating Objects
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of existing floating objects. (2 - 1024)

configurationFields.label: Minimum World Size
configurationFields.description: World size can't be selected lower than this value. (0 - 2147483646)

configurationFields.label: Physics Iterations
configurationFields.description: Defines the number of physics iterations. (2 - 32)

configurationFields.label: Prefetch Voxels Range Limit
configurationFields.description: Defines at what maximum distance weapons could interact with voxels. (0 - 100000)

configurationFields.label: Procedural Density
configurationFields.description: Defines density of the procedurally generated content.

configurationFields.label: Procedural Seed
configurationFields.description: Defines unique starting seed for the procedurally generated content.

configurationFields.label: Enable Realistic Sound
configurationFields.description: Enable realistic sounds.

configurationFields.label: Enable Scrap Drops
configurationFields.description: Allow scrap to be dropped from destroyed blocks.

configurationFields.label: Solar Radiation Intensity
configurationFields.description: A multiplier for the amount of radiation gained in space from sun exposure. Requires Airtightness and Radiation. (0 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Sun Rotation Interval
configurationFields.description: Defines interval of one rotation of the sun. (0 - 1440)

configurationFields.label: Sync Distance
configurationFields.description: Defines synchronization distance in multiplayer. High distance can slow down server drastically. Use with caution. (1000 - 20000)

configurationFields.label: Enable Temporary Containers
configurationFields.description: Enable Temporary Container to spawn after destroying block with inventory.

configurationFields.label: Bot Limit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of organic bots in the world. (16 - 1024)

configurationFields.label: Max Cargo Bags Lifetime
configurationFields.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for cargo bags to be alive before deletion. (2 - 1024)

configurationFields.label: Voxel Generator Version
configurationFields.description: Selects the voxel generator version.

configurationFields.label: Enable Weather System
configurationFields.description: Enables automatic weather generation on planets.

configurationFields.label: Enable Lightning Damage
configurationFields.description: Lightning strikes from weather can damage grids.

configurationFields.label: World Size
configurationFields.description: Defines the size of the world. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Enable Cargo Ships
configurationFields.description: Enables spawning of cargo ships.

configurationFields.label: Economy Tick Time
configurationFields.description: Time period between two economy updates. (300 - 3600)

configurationFields.label: Enable Drones
configurationFields.description: Enable spawning of drones in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Economy
configurationFields.description: Enables economy features.

configurationFields.label: Enable Encounters
configurationFields.description: Enables random encounters in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable ORCA
configurationFields.description: Enable advanced Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance.

configurationFields.label: Enable Planetary Encounters
configurationFields.description: Enable planetary encounters in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Spiders
configurationFields.description: Enables spawning of spiders in the world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Wolves
configurationFields.description: Enables spawning of wolves in the world.

configurationFields.label: Global Encounter Cap
configurationFields.description: Maximum of active Global Encounters at the same time. Turned off when 0.

configurationFields.label: Global Encounter Enable Removal
configurationFields.description: Enable removal of Global Encounters.

configurationFields.label: Removal Timer Max
configurationFields.description: Maximum removal timer of Global Encounters. (91 - 180)

configurationFields.label: Removal Timer Min
configurationFields.description: Minimum removal timer of Global Encounters. (0 - 180)

configurationFields.label: Global Encounter PCU
configurationFields.description: Number of Performance Cost Units allocated for global encounters. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Removal Time Clock
configurationFields.description: When the game should start countown for removal of Global Encounters. (15 - 60)

configurationFields.label: Global Encounter Timer
configurationFields.description: Global Encounter spawns every X minutes. (1 - 1440)

configurationFields.label: Claim Time For NPC Grids
configurationFields.description: Time period in which player can claim NPC grid. NPC block do despawn after time limit ends. (1 - 1440)

configurationFields.label: NPC PCU
configurationFields.description: Number of Performance Cost Units allocated for pirate faction. (0 - 2147483647)

configurationFields.label: Existing Installations Allowed
configurationFields.description: Claim area radius for Planetary Encounter spawns - no more installations would spawn there until clean-up. (1000 - 120000)

configurationFields.label: Desired Spawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Player-based distance for Planetary Encounter spawns. (1000 - 15000)

configurationFields.label: Installations Despawn Timeout
configurationFields.description: Timeout for permanent installation auto-removal. (5 - 1440)

configurationFields.label: Existing Structures Allowed
configurationFields.description: Minimum distance to existing structures for Planetary Encounter spawns. (1000 - 10000)

configurationFields.label: Presence Distance
configurationFields.description: Player presence within this range prevents installation auto-removal. (3000 - 120000)

configurationFields.label: Installations Timer First
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the first planetary encounter occurs. (1 - 240)

configurationFields.label: Installations Timer Max
configurationFields.description: Maximum for Planetary Encounter spawn timer. (1 - 240)

configurationFields.label: Installations Timer Min
configurationFields.description: Minimum for Planetary Encounter spawn timer. (1 - 240)

configurationFields.label: Stations Inner Radius
configurationFields.description: The inner radius [m] (center is in 0,0,0), where stations can spawn. Does not affect planet-bound stations (Surface Outposts and Orbital Stations). (200000 - 9223372036854780000)

configurationFields.label: Stations Outer Radius End
configurationFields.description: The outer radius [m] (center is in 0,0,0), where stations can spawn. Does not affect planet-bound stations (Surface Outposts and Orbital Stations). (1000000 - 9223372036854780000)

configurationFields.label: Stations Outer Radius Start
configurationFields.description: The outer radius [m] (center is in 0,0,0), where stations can spawn. Does not affect planet-bound stations (Surface Outposts and Orbital Stations). (500000 - 9223372036854780000)

configurationFields.label: NPC Factions Count
configurationFields.description: The number of NPC factions generated on the start of the world. (8 - 100)

configurationFields.label: Enable Faction Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: Faction Voice Chat removes the need of antennas and broadcasting of the character for faction.

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: Enables friendly fire damage.

configurationFields.label: Enable Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: Enables automatic team balancing.

configurationFields.label: Enemy Target Indicator Distance
configurationFields.description: Defines the maximum distance to display the enemy target indicator. (0 - 1000)

configurationFields.label: Match Restart When Empty
configurationFields.description: Server will restart after specified time, when it's empty after match started. Works only in PvP scenarios. When 0 feature is disabled. (0 - 1440)

configurationFields.label: Enable Ingame Scripts
configurationFields.description: Allows scripts loaded from in game computer terminals to work. Also requires Experimental Mode enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Share Inertia Tensor
configurationFields.description: Enables sharing of the Inertia Tensor of mechanical blocks. Also requires Experimental Mode enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Spectator Camera
configurationFields.description: Enables spectator camera.

configurationFields.label: Enable Sub-Grid Damage
configurationFields.description: Enables sub-grid damage.

configurationFields.label: Enable Supergridding
configurationFields.description: Allows super gridding exploit to be used.

configurationFields.label: Enable Unsafe Piston Impulses
configurationFields.description: Enables unsafe impulses (experimental feature) for Piston blocks.

configurationFields.label: Enable Unsafe Rotor Torques
configurationFields.description: Enables unsafe torques (experimental feature) for Rotor blocks.

configurationFields.label: Permanent Death
configurationFields.description: Enables permanent death.

configurationFields.label: Reset Ownership
configurationFields.description: Reset ownership of all blocks to nobody.

configurationFields.label: Unsupported Stations
configurationFields.description: By enabling this option grids will no longer turn dynamic when disconnected from static grids.

configurationFields.label: Server Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Which release stream should be used to update the server. Choose a custom release on [SteamDB](https://steamdb.info/app/298740/depots/) and enter the Branch Name below.

deploymentSteps.name: Base Config Download

    <GameMode>Survival</GameMode>
    <InventorySizeMultiplier>3</InventorySizeMultiplier>
    <BlocksInventorySizeMultiplier>1</BlocksInventorySizeMultiplier>
    <AssemblerSpeedMultiplier>3</AssemblerSpeedMultiplier>

    <RefinerySpeedMultiplier>3</RefinerySpeedMultiplier>
    <OnlineMode>PUBLIC</OnlineMode>
    <MaxPlayers>4</MaxPlayers>
    <MaxFloatingObjects>56</MaxFloatingObjects>
    <TotalBotLimit>32</TotalBotLimit>
    <MaxBackupSaves>5</MaxBackupSaves>
    <MaxGridSize>0</MaxGridSize>
    <MaxBlocksPerPlayer>0</MaxBlocksPerPlayer>

    <EnableRespawnShips>true</EnableRespawnShips>
    <ScenarioEditMode>false</ScenarioEditMode>
    <Scenario>false</Scenario>

    <CanJoinRunning>false</CanJoinRunning>
    <PhysicsIterations>8</PhysicsIterations>

    <EnableVoxelDestruction>true</EnableVoxelDestruction>

    <EnableSubgridDamage>false</EnableSubgridDamage>
    <SyncDistance>3000</SyncDistance>

    <AdaptiveSimulationQuality>true</AdaptiveSimulationQuality>
    <EnableVoxelHand>true</EnableVoxelHand>
    <RemoveOldIdentitiesH>0</RemoveOldIdentitiesH>

    <OptimalGridCount>0</OptimalGridCount>
    <PlayerInactivityThreshold>0</PlayerInactivityThreshold>

    <VoxelTrashRemovalEnabled>false</VoxelTrashRemovalEnabled>
    <VoxelPlayerDistanceThreshold>5000</VoxelPlayerDistanceThreshold>
    <VoxelGridDistanceThreshold>5000</VoxelGridDistanceThreshold>

deploymentSteps.name: Winescript Download
deploymentSteps.source:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_NAME=$(echo \"$0\" | xargs readlink -f)
SCRIPTDIR=$(dirname "$SCRIPT_NAME")

exec 6>display.log
/usr/bin/Xvfb -displayfd 6 -nolisten tcp -nolisten unix &
XVFB_PID=$!
while [[ ! -s display.log ]]; do
  sleep 1
done
read -r DPY_NUM < display.log
rm display.log

export WINEPREFIX="$SCRIPTDIR/space-engineers-generic/.wine"
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG=fixme-all
export DISPLAY=:$DPY_NUM

[[ -f winetricks ]] && rm -f winetricks
wget -q https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/refs/tags/20260125/src/winetricks
chmod +x winetricks
wget -q -O $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi https://dl.winehq.org/wine/wine-mono/9.1.0/wine-mono-9.1.0-x86.msi

/usr/bin/wine msiexec /i $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi /qn /quiet /norestart /log $WINEPREFIX/mono_install.log

PACKAGES="win11 vcrun2022 corefonts"
echo "" > winescript_log.txt 2>&1
for PACKAGE in $PACKAGES; do
  ./winetricks -q $PACKAGE >> winescript_log.txt 2>&1
done
rm -rf ~/.cache/winetricks ~/.cache/fontconfig

exec 6>&-
kill $XVFB_PID

exit 0
